home.title: Home
home.body: Your society's summary will show here.
home.attentionNone: Nothing needs your attention right now.

attention.runWaiting: Bills for {{period}} are waiting for approval

noSociety.title: You are not part of a society yet
noSociety.body: Set up your society now, or ask your society admin to send you an invite link.

setup.title: Set up your society
setup.name: Society name
setup.dueDays: Payment due (days after the bill date)
setup.upiHelp: For the payment QR code on bills. Optional.
setup.bankLast4: Last 4 digits of the bank account
setup.bankLast4Help: Shown on bills. Never the full number.
setup.inviteLater: Add the people who run the society with you. You can also do this later.
setup.needContact: Add an email or phone number

invites.title: People and invites
invites.adminOnly: Only the society admin can add people and send invites.
invites.name: Name
invites.linkBody: Sending invites by email is coming soon. For now, copy each link and send it to the person. Each link works once.
invites.noFlats: Add flats first, then invite owners and tenants.
invites.needFlat: Choose the flat for this person

flats.title: Flats and members
flats.empty: No flats yet. The quickest way is to import them from Excel.
flats.invalidArea: Enter the area in square feet, for example 650
flats.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in rupees, for example 960000

fields.flatTypeHelp: For example 1BHK. Shown only; not used for charges.
fields.costHelp: Architect-certified cost of the flat. Used for sinking and repair funds.

members.title: People in this flat
members.endQuestion: Mark {{name}} as moved out today? Their past records stay.

wings.title: Wings and lifts
wings.body: Lift charges are shared only by flats in wings that have a lift.
wings.name: Wing name
wings.nameHelp: For example A, B or Tower 1

import.title: Import flats from Excel
import.body: Add all flats, owners, tenants and opening balances at once. Nothing is saved until you check and confirm.
import.step1Body: Fill one row per flat. The second sheet explains each column.
import.step2Body: We check every row and show you what we found.
import.confirmQuestion: Import {{count}} flats now? {{skipped}} rows that need fixing will be skipped.
import.skipped: {{count}} rows were skipped. Fix them in the file and import again.

issues.tooManyDecimals: {{field}} has more than 2 digits after the point.
issues.invalidEmail: {{field}} is not a valid email address.
issues.duplicateInFile: The same flat is also in row {{otherRow}}.
issues.alreadyExists: This flat is already in SocietyIQ.
issues.liftConflict: Wing {{wing}} has a different lift answer in row {{otherRow}}.
issues.liftDiffers: Wing {{wing}} is saved with a different lift answer; the import will not change it.
issues.tenantPhoneNoName: Tenant phone is given but tenant name is empty.
issues.carpetMissing: Carpet area is empty; it is needed for some charges.
issues.costMissing: Construction cost is empty; it is needed for sinking and repair funds.
issues.letOutNoTenant: The flat is let out but no tenant is given.
issues.flatNotFound: This flat is not in SocietyIQ. Check the wing and flat number.
issues.exemptWithAmount: An exempt flat cannot have an amount.
issues.exemptionReasonMissing: Give the reason for the exemption.

charges.title: Charges
charges.body: The charges on every bill. Each one is split between flats the way the law sets; you enter only the amounts your general body approved.
charges.perPeriod: for the whole society each bill
charges.empty: No charges yet. Start with service charges.
charges.chooseBody: Each comes with the way the law says to split it.
charges.needMonth: Choose the month for this one-time charge
charges.name: Name on the bill
charges.howSplit: How is it split between flats?
charges.statutoryHelp: Set by {{rule}}. Change it only if your general body decided so.
charges.nonOccupancyNote: Fixed at {{percent}}% of the flat's service charges, only for flats that are let out ({{rule}}).
charges.fundMinimumNote: At least {{percent}}% a year of each flat's certified construction cost ({{rule}}).
charges.deviationHint: This is not the usual way for this charge. You will need to give a reason and the general body resolution.
charges.total: Total for the whole society, each bill (₹)
charges.totalHelp: As approved by the general body. SocietyIQ splits it between flats.
charges.percentOfCost: Percentage a year of the certified construction cost
charges.perFlatNote: This charge is zero unless you set an amount on a flat's page.
charges.assessedNote: Each flat pays the amount from its municipal bill. Enter it on the flat's page or import it from Excel.
charges.parkingNote: Each flat pays for the parking slots allotted to it. Add slots on the flat's page.
charges.reasonHelp: Why this is different from the rule. It is kept in the record.

problems.interestAboveCap: Interest is above the legal maximum of {{max}}% a year.
problems.interestNeedsResolution: Interest needs the general body rate and the date of its resolution.
problems.needsTotal: Enter the total for the whole society.
problems.needsBaseHead: Choose which charge this is a percentage of.
problems.nonOccupancyMethod: Non-occupancy charges must be a percentage of service charges.
problems.nonOccupancyPercent: Non-occupancy charges must be exactly {{required}}% of service charges.
problems.nonOccupancyBase: Non-occupancy charges can only be on service charges.
problems.nonOccupancyLetOut: Non-occupancy charges apply only to flats that are let out.
problems.belowFundMinimum: This is below the legal minimum of {{minimum}}% a year. Give a reason to save it.
problems.methodDeviation: The rule says: {{method}}. Give a reason and the general body resolution.

method.equal_per_flat_with_lift: Split equally between flats in wings with a lift
method.per_water_point: Split by number of water taps
method.as_assessed_per_flat: Each flat's amount from the municipal bill
method.pct_of_construction_cost: A percentage of the flat's construction cost
method.fixed_per_flat: The same fixed amount for every flat
method.custom_per_flat: An amount set for each flat

standard.other: Other charge approved by the general body

billingSettings.title: Billing and interest
billingSettings.roundingHelp: A 'Rounding off' line shows the difference, so the lines always add up.
billingSettings.interestBody: Off unless your general body decided a rate. Simple interest only, never interest on interest.
billingSettings.rateHelp: The general body rate. The legal maximum is checked when you save.
billingSettings.resolutionDate: Date of the general body resolution
billingSettings.grace: Days of grace after the due date

preview.body: What each flat will be charged, before any bill is made. Nothing here is sent to anyone.

missing.carpet_area: {{count}} flats have no carpet area yet
missing.construction_cost: {{count}} flats have no construction cost yet
missing.water_points: {{count}} flats have no number of water taps yet

preview.leftOutTitle: Left out until the information is added

reasons.missingAssessment: no property tax amount for this year

taxImport.title: Property tax from Excel
taxImport.body: Copy each flat's yearly amount from the municipal bill. SocietyIQ never calculates municipal tax.

parking.title: Parking
parking.note: Parking is allotted, never sold. The rate is the one your general body fixed.
parking.rateHelp: As fixed by the general body

tax.title: Property tax
tax.note: From the municipal bill. A newer entry for the same year replaces the older one.
tax.exempt: The bill shows this flat as exempt
tax.needReason: Give the reason for the exemption

overrides.title: Special amounts
overrides.note: Replace one charge for this flat, for example after a general body decision. Always give the reason.
overrides.head: Which charge?
overrides.reasonHelp: It is kept in the record

billing.title: Bills
billing.body: Bills are made once for each period. First a draft you can check; nothing reaches residents until you approve it.
billing.createNote: SocietyIQ also makes the draft by itself on your bill date.

warnings.zeroAmount: {{flat}} has nothing to pay this period

billing.approverOnly: The admin or treasurer approves bills.
billing.approveQuestion: Approve {{count}} bills for {{total}}? Each bill gets a number and is added to the flat's account. A wrong bill can later be cancelled and corrected.
billing.cancelBillNote: The bill stays in the records marked cancelled, and its amount is taken off the flat's account. You can then issue a corrected bill.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Money received from flats. A receipt is made only when you confirm a payment.
payments.referenceHelp: UPI reference or bank UTR, if you have it
payments.chequeNote: A cheque is confirmed when it clears. Open it later and tap "Cleared" or "Bounced".
payments.confirmNow: I can see this money; confirm it now and make the receipt
payments.noReceiptYet: The receipt is made when you confirm this payment.
payments.bounceNote: The cheque did not clear. Nothing was added to the flat's account, so nothing changes there.
payments.reverseNote: The payment stays in the records marked reversed. Its amount goes back on the flat's account and the receipt is cancelled.
payments.confirmQuestion: Confirm {{amount}} from {{flat}}? A receipt will be made and the flat's dues will go down.

dues.title: Dues
dues.body: Flats that owe money, largest first. Only committee members can see this list.
dues.none: No flat in this group owes anything.

step.long: The committee may consider a recovery application under section 154B-29 of the MCS Act (Form Y-6, Rule 106C-14). Consult your legal adviser.

ledger.title: Account of flat {{flat}}
ledger.recoveryNote: The statement lists every bill, payment, interest line and reversal, and the general body resolutions behind the charges, as needed for a recovery application.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.body: Audits, AMCs, insurance and services the society must keep up to date. Reminders go to the committee only.
compliance.empty: No items yet. Add the audits and AMCs your society tracks.
compliance.markDoneQuestion: Mark {{title}} as done on {{date}}? The next due date will be set from the repeat interval.

form.title: Name
form.titleHelp: Leave empty to use the type as the name.
form.repeatHelp: As your contract or rule says. Leave empty if it does not repeat.
form.repeatInvalid: Enter a whole number of months from 1 to 120.
form.amountInvalid: Enter the amount in rupees, for example 192000.

admin.title: Records
admin.body: Download all of your society's data, and see who changed what and when.
admin.homeLink: Records: download data and see the change history

export.title: Download all data
export.body: Every record of this society: flats, members, bills, payments, complaints, compliance and the change history. The download is noted in the change history.
